decisions.reason: As a finish variant that is very close to the core drainage range, it fits the firm's existing design, production and channel knowledge and can be refined efficiently through customer feedback.
This shower channel is tightly aligned with the firm's established drainage competence, and the firm's own R&D and installer-oriented support should help it learn quickly and improve market fit.

Although technically more demanding, the pump-assisted drainage solution still builds on the firm's drainage know-how, and its in-house development capability gives it a good basis to absorb early lessons and commercialise improvements.

The tileable floor drain is closely related to the firm's established offer and customer base, so it benefits strongly from existing technical knowledge, sales channels and complementary planning support.

The stainless steel design grate is a near-adjacent extension of the core portfolio and supports the firm's strategy of combining engineering with aesthetics, making it low-risk to retain and optimise.
